symptom: ako/mxcli#1932 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1730): a Delete button in a Data grid 2 control bar — Studio Pro stores Forms$DeleteClientAction.SourceVariable = Forms$PageVariable{Widget: grid1}; MDL `action: delete` wrote no source and mx check reported CE7005 "No value selection has been made" while check --references passed; describe printed a stored source as plain `delete`, so describe → exec dropped it
cause: Three layers each lacked the property: pages.DeleteClientAction had no field, clientActionToGen never set gen's SourceVariable, renderClientActionBaseMDL read only ClosePage. The grammar had no slot either (`delete $x`)
file: mdl/executor/cmd_pages_delete_source.go (deleteSource, deleteWithoutObjectProblem, validateDeleteSource); mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_write.go (DeleteClientAction case); mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_output.go; mdl/grammar/domains/MDLPage.g4 (DELETE VARIABLE?)
insight: **Reuse the selection machinery, do not invent one**: `$grid1` already meant a grid's selection for flow arguments (#1560) — classifyFlowArgValue resolves it, pageVariableToGen writes it, flowArgVariableValue reads it back — so the fix is three call sites, not a new resolver. Measured on mx 11.12.1, both variants: fixed `delete $grid1` → 0 errors; the writer's SetSourceVariable disabled → CE7005 on both buttons; a bare delete at a page root (via ALTER INSERT, where the guard stands down) → CE7005, which is what justifies refusing it at the root too; `delete $Order` (page parameter) → 0 errors. **A second trap behind the first**: with the grid's itemSelection left at None, the selection source is CE7001 "Widget should be placed inside Data grid 2 'grid1' to use it as a source widget" — the message names placement, the cause is the grid having no selection; check does not report that yet. The property-set half: all 13 Studio Pro Delete actions in ako/TestApp store SourceVariable null and mxcli omitted the key — registered as a NullFields default, which the version stripper drops below 10.4. The VARIABLE alternative on `delete` collides with actionExprV3's first branch (`$handler` fragment param) — buildActionV3 must exclude delete before testing VARIABLE
